profile.reading: This building, tagged DC05, is one of eight mapped structures on Data4 Italia MIL01 campus at Via Monzoro 101-105 in Cornaredo, a suburb of Milan, Italy. Data4, styled DATA4, is a European data center developer and operator founded in 2006 and headquartered in Paris, France, which its own 2019 published materials describe as controlled by AXA, the French insurance and asset-management group, though the specific AXA entity and any co-investors could not be independently confirmed this session. Data4 own site describes a six-country European footprint spanning France, Italy, Spain, Poland, Germany, and Greece, totaling roughly ten campuses, 1.5 gigawatts of capacity, and 165,000 square meters of IT space group-wide. Data4 has operated in Italy since 2012, developing the Cornaredo campus in progressive phases according to the company own Italian-language press materials. As of an October 2018 company announcement, three data centers were fully operational on the campus with nearly all of that space allocated to customers, and Data4 had banked land for up to seven additional buildings while planning a fourth-generation facility of roughly 2,000 square meters and 3 megawatts of IT power to a Tier 4 design target. That fourth building was formally inaugurated at a June 2019 campus event, and the DC05 numbering suggests this building followed as a later phase of that same expansion plan, though the exact construction or opening date for DC05 specifically could not be confirmed. Data4 current Milan-area location page describes the Cornaredo site, referred to as MIL01, as a 217 megawatt, 20 hectare campus, distinct from a separate second Milan-area site in Vittuone known as MIL02. No Data4 source reviewed breaks the 217 megawatt campus figure down by individual building, so no capacity or square footage figure specific to DC05 alone is asserted here, and no tenant is named.
profile.capacity_note: Campus level total published, 170 MW and 20 hectares, not broken down per building, so no per building MW or square footage figure is recorded.
